In today's episode of The Daily Brief, we cover two stories shaping Indian and global markets:
1. India's Bullet Train Journey
India's first bullet train project is finally nearing completion after years of delays, rising costs, and engineering challenges. We explain why building a high-speed rail network is so difficult, why India couldn't simply upgrade existing tracks, and what this project means for the country's transport future.
